items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: But Ann Cook was a hustling woman, I know her.

ctx.x: Yeah, she sang with Louis Delaney on the record.
She was after I left here, yeah. But Ann Cook was a hustling woman, I know her.
Well, she's a singer now, a church worker, you know, a big woman in the church.
